intro: The Big Picture is a Northshire Valley task concerning a thieving kobold named Shinyfinder Narf, who has been hoarding stolen books deep within the local mine. Adventurers are dispatched by local authorities to recover the illustrated volumes and return them to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.
Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for returning these stolen books, friend. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.
You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
